unit.why: Sayings §§21–25 of R. Pinhas (of Korets), quoted from Shiftei Tsaddikim and Shemuot Tovot, are all homiletic and kabbalistic teachings: the light of each person and the angel born when two people meet, studying shelo lishmah, parashat Tetsaveh and Purim, Rashi on 'hevei kibbel ve-kayyem', and the Shabbat zemer. None of them narrates an event.
